characters.name: Rex Salazar
characters.description: Rex is a charming teenager with a sharp sense of humor and a thirst for adventure (at least, if you ask him). He is living the dream as the point man of a high-powered super-spy team and is amazed by the weird world he's a part of, and most definitely digs the spotlight as Providence's weapon of choice. It's like being a super-powered rock star, most of the time. Like any teen, there's a lot going on with Rex that keeps him awake at night – mainly the amnesia that's robbed him of his past. He can't remember anything beyond the few months before joining Providence because they promised to help him learn where he comes from. He is driven toward any clues that might help unlock his memories or better understand and master the strange but wonderful machines banging around inside of him. 10-Minute Retirement: In "The Hunter". Adaptation Dye-Job: Blonde in the original comics; black-haired in the cartoon. All-Loving Hero: For all the jerkassery he is capable of, Rex always does his best to help and save the people around him. All the Other Reindeer: Has shades of this in the early episodes, most prominently in the pilot episode, given his heartbroken look when the kids he thought he had made friends with called him a freak and laughed.

characters.name: Agent Six
characters.description: A senior-level operative for Providence, Six is literally the sixth deadliest man on the planet. Highly skilled in every form of combat and trained in methods of intrigue, Six is the ultimate bodyguard to Rex. His stoic nature and lightning-fast mind have made him a prized operative, and explain why he was given the assignment of helping Rex learn how to utilize his powerful abilities. Unfortunately, Six doesn't have much patience for undisciplined partners, unreliable machines, and especially smart-mouthed teenagers! So from the onset, Rex and Six have an abrasive "odd couple" relationship. Amazon Chaser: When it came to Holiday's obvious crush on him, at best, he was genuinely oblivious, at worst, he just plain wasn't interested. Seeing her shooting rapid-fire at an E.V.O. changed his mind. Amnesiac Dissonance:Six of six years ago is willing to kill on a whim, fancies himself a ladies' man (probably not unjustifiably so), and isn't a team player. Thankfully, though he never recovers his memories, it doesn't take much for him to start emulating the man he would become after seeing how much Rex trusted him. Asskicking Leads to Leadership: Subverted. He's arguably a better combatant than the 2nd through 5th most dangerous people in the world, but he's considered somewhat 'less dangerous' because of hisHeart Of Gold. Badass in a Nice Suit: Never seen without his trademark green suit and tie.

characters.name: Bobo Haha
characters.description: One of the earliest Providence captures, Bobo is an intelligent monkey who can speak his mind. Despite his darker origins, Bobo has chosen to fight for good in his own gruff way. Bobo is always by Rex's side and fiercely loyal to the boy who saved him. Bobo sports a "shoot then aim" attitude towards every situation that he and Rex find themselves in, and is constantly giving absurd advice to Rex, encouraging his more mischievous side. Barefoot Cartoon Animal: Being a monkey, it would be pretty stupid of him to cover his prehensile feet with shoes. Berserk Button: Do not interrupt his nap.Bobo: Bobo gets cranky!(starts shooting bad guys left and right)Rex:I learned that the hard way, too. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: He doesn't tend to do much, but the flashback episode revealed that he used to do things like sneak into the Kremlin and try to pressThe Button...forfun. Along with that, he also proves to be rather capable in a fight, such ascurb-stomping Biowulf and Skalamander at the same time. Dark and Troubled Past: His past is a mystery, but from what he divulges in his rants, it can be concluded that he used to live in a harsh, unforgiving jungle until he (according to Holiday) became a helper animal before becoming an E.V.O., after which he then became an international criminal and world-renowned prankster of dangerous proportions before being captured and drafted by Providence.

characters.name: Noah Nixon
characters.description: Noah is in every way a regular kid, except for one thing: he is secretly employed by Providence to be Rex's friend. This deception ultimately weighs heavily on Noah, who genuinely likes Rex. Noah provides a dose of reality and normalcy in Rex's life and is there for him, whether it's to play basketball or to offer advice. The Ace: It's eventually shown that Noah does, in fact, have his act together very well, being popular, intelligent, and surprisingly well-connected in school and life, as well as being a veteran, if not well-practiced, combatant. Rex, by contrast, is a clumsy goof around people his age. Action Survivor: After a short stay at Providence boot camp, he's more than willing to grab a gun when it comes to that. Alliterative Name:NoahNixon. Becoming the Mask: Was hired to be Rex's civilian friend, but would come to regret this decision when Rex found out, as he grew to like spending time with him. After some convincing by Holiday, they became friends for real.

characters.name: Dr. Rebecca "Doc" Holiday
characters.description: Genius scientist extraordinaire, Doctor Holiday works for Providence as tech support, but her main focus, though, is Rex. She monitors his emotions, the state of the nanites inside him, and his general health. Holiday has taken a much more maternal interest in Rex and seems to be the only person at Providence who truly cares for his emotional well-being. Holiday is not afraid to speak her mind, and though she respects authority, she answers first and foremost to science. She's quick-witted, clever, and direct. It's almost always impossible to pull something over on Holiday. Badass Bookworm: When you consider the fact that she's more of a scientist. Brainy Brunette: Fits all of the stereotypes. Cool Big Sis: With some flavor ofBig Sister Instinctwhen it comes to Rexand, most especially, her E.V.O. sister, Beverly. Crazy-Prepared: Really, Holiday? You either had ready, or set up in under 8 minutes, an interrogation room with hand scanners, a trapdoor, descending wall-thingy, Breach-sized restraints, and a PROBE CANNON?

characters.name: White Knight
characters.description: The Agent in charge at Providence, his ultimate quest is to rid the world of E.V.O.s (Exponentially Variegated Organism). White harbors an almost irrational fear of nanites, to the point where he never leaves his stark white office, which also doubles as a high-tech nanite-free clean room. As far as anyone can tell, he never leaves the sterilized room he calls an office, as apparent by his flour-white skin and the fact that he keeps a jar of milk in a drawer. While there is not exactly a heart of gold hidden beneath his gruff exterior, he does genuinely want to do the right thing and is often faced with making really tough decisions. Once a friend and partner of Six, their relationship is showing signs of serious strain. 24-Hour Armor:After being forced out of Providence during theTime Skip. Due to being deprived of his Clean Room, he's taken to wearing his hermetically-sealed armor constantly. Anti-Hero: He can be reasonable, and it's shown that he is a competent, if stern and cynical, leader. Back-to-Back Badasses: He and Six used to be this, back when he was actually in the thick of it during the early days of Providence. Big Good:Just barely.He is in charge of Providence and all of the good guys, but it's a stretch to call him a good person.

characters.name: César Salazar
characters.description: Rex's older brother is one of the scientists who worked on the Nanite Project. He managed to escape the lab he worked in before the nanite explosion, only for his portable lab to move at light speed(!) for 15 minutes (5 years in real-time). Knew Van Kleiss and Rex before the nanite incident. Absent-Minded Professor: He's a genius and a nice guy, but a little... kooky. Beard of Evil:He grows a goatee after the six-monthTime Skip, and he also has hisFace–Heel Turnby then. He ends up shaving it off two episodes later, though. Beware the Nice Ones/Beware the Silly Ones:He can be caustic and hostile at the drop of a hat if challenged. Even to Rex. Hell, the way he eventually starts treating Rex hints at quite a cruel streak. SeeCrouching Moron, Hidden Badassbelow. Cannot Spit It Out: He has an amazingly bad habit of refusing to volunteer any information unless he feels like doing so. It took an entire season just to get him to reveal the truth behind the nanite event.

characters.name: Captain Calan
characters.description: Providence Captain, and a major ally to White Knight. He makes several appearances throughout the show. Badass Normal: Not to Six's extent, but he's still competent in a fight. Death from Above: When getting into a fight with the Pack over Rylander's laboratory, Providence takes a few losses, so Calan orders them to bomb the lab. Empowered Badass Normal: Once turned into an E.V.O. by Van Kleiss. Gets cured by Rex in the end. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Has a scar over his eye. As seen in "Promises, Promises", he got it in the five years from when Rex was recruited, to the present.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Big Bad Wannabe:For all the hype they've gotten, they're literally little more than Providence's bankroll. They're a bunch of middle-aged men who want power, but don't have the slightest clue about what Providence or Rex go through on a daily basis in pursuit of it. All they do is throw money at them. As far as cleverness or competence goes, none of them holds a torch to Black Knight or Van Kleiss of old. Even their Meta upgrade does little to change this: they have no idea how to use their individual powers effectively and completely rely on Black Knight's lead. Even the idea to tear Rex apart as payback was Black Knight's. Body Horror:They come out of the Meta-Nanites empowering in "End-Game" as robots. Not as much squick as usual for the trope, but they're blocky, metallic, and with miscellaneous hydraulics sticking out of them. Essentially, they went in as humans and came out as living action figures. Which they didnotsee coming. Bullying a Dragon: They constantly make misogynistic comments towards Black Knight,despite knowing of her E.V.O. powers. Chekhov's Gunman: One of them shows up in season 1, being turned into a temporary E.V.O. by Rylander to force him to pay the funding to complete the project. When the Consortium becomes Rex's main order of business, the same man is shown to have become a nervous wreck as a result, used to help provide information. Color-Coded for Your Convenience:After fusing with the Meta-Nanites.

characters.name: Black Knight
characters.description: After being transported six months into the future via Breach's powers, Rex finds that Black Knight has inexplicably taken over for White Knight as head of Providence, removing Six and Holiday in the process. Though she is at all times polite and kind, her methods and motives are questionable at best. Action Girl: Much like Holiday. Though she tends to stay out of the action, she often leads from the front lines.She's eventually revealed to be more dangerous than it was first implied Affably Evil: Offers Rex refreshments and is nothing but courteous in their first meeting, and is polite and even soft-spoken at all times.Doesn't change the fact that she's deposed White Knight and gotten rid of Six and Holiday, and that her methods are by and large inhumane to E.V.O.'s and employees alike. Or the whole "becoming a god" thing. Anti-Villain: She's a Type III.Or so she pretends.

characters.name: Roswell
characters.description: A business mogul hailing from the south. Brash and blunt, Roswell demands results more than details. Black Knight's presentation on the Meta-Nanites intrigued Roswell, which influenced him into following Black Knight's lead in return for power.When merged with the Meta-Nanites, he gains control over temperature. Americans Are Cowboys: He's dressed up like a cowboy and even has the accent. Everything Is Big in Texas: "Go big or go home...", in conjunction with his accent. An Ice Person:Gains the power to control ice after absorbing one of the Meta-Nanites. Playing with Fire:Gains this ability after absorbing one of the Meta-Nanites.

characters.name: Reddick
characters.description: A real estate and construction magnate, Reddick first appeared at Black Knight's presentation on the Meta-Nanites at a Providence facility with the rest of the Consortium. To Black Knight's dismay, Reddick wasn't particularly impressed by her efforts.When merged with the Meta-Nanites, he gains control over gravity. Flat Character: Isn't given any characterization throughout his appearances. The Generic Guy: Certainly the most white-bread of the Consortium. Gravity Master:His main E.V.O. ability he obtains from the Meta-Nanites

characters.name: Sir Anthony Haden-Scott
characters.description: Not much is known about him, other than his part in the Consortium. He's first seen attending a special meeting of Providence, organized by Black Knight.When merged with the Meta-Nanites, he gains control over matter and energy. Aristocrats Are Evil: He looks like a British aristocrat, and given that he has the title of sir, he likely is one. Evil Brit: Speaks with a clearly British accent. Evil Old Folks: He appears to be somewhat older than the rest of the Consortium. Shock and Awe:Obtains this power after merging with the Meta-Nanites.

characters.name: Xanubian
characters.description: An arms dealer masquerading as an industrial shipping professional. He first appeared, along with the rest of the consortium, at Black Knights Meta-Nanites presentation. He prefers to listen before voicing an opinion.When merged with the Meta-Nanites, he gained control over time. Arms Dealer: He's described as an arms dealer. Flat Character: He is given no characterization outside of being a stoic arms dealer. The Quiet One: He never utters a word, even in the presence of his own associates.Lampshadedby Roswell, who sarcastically calls him "Mr. Chatterbox". The Stoic: He never visibly shows any emotion.

characters.name: Vostok
characters.description: A KGB agent working as a black market money-lender. Vostok first appeared at a meeting held with Black Knight and the Consortium. He seemed to have much doubt about whatever Black Knight presented to them about the Meta-Nanites and the Nanite Project.This, however, angered Black Knight, forcing her to kill him. Killed Off for Real:He is killed by Black Knight after he chooses to stay behind during the attack on the Consortium's base. Loan Shark: He's described as a black market money-lender. Make an Example of Them:Black Knightretroactively uses him as an example of what happens to those who cross her. Too Dumb to Live: When Rex, Six, and Jungle Cat attack the Consortium's base, he is the only member who doesn't evacuate. Reddick even lampshades this as he leaves.

characters.name: Van Kleiss
characters.description: Van Kleiss is described as every mad scientist you ever saw, only a lot freakier and more dangerous. His body's molecular structure is unstable and thus has to stabilize himself using Nanites extracted from E.V.O.s captured by the Pack and experimented upon by him. He possesses the ability to control everything in his Kingdom Abysus, but out of his territory, he cannot use his powers. He knows a great deal about the Nanites, which cause E.V.O. Mutations and about Rex's past (implying he had a hand in his mutation), and claims that he will tell Rex everything, but only if Rex joins his team. Achilles' Heel: He is powerless unless he is on his native soil. He spends a lot of time trying to get around this, while at the same time exploiting his own weakness so people won't think he's a threat. Action Survivor: The whole "A Brief History of Time" is about Van Kliess trying to survive and return to the present. And I Must Scream: After "Lions and Lambs", Van Kleiss was sent to ancient Egypt. While there, he became aware of a cosmic presence trying to eliminate him because of his tampering with history. He decided he needed to get back to his own time and so built a device to do so. Unfortunately, the device he used (resembling a sarcophagus) opened up way too early, landing him in ancient Rome. He repeats the process again and again, rebuilding the device in each era, each time traveling a little further into the future, constantly terrified of the presence following him.When he finally returns to the present time, it's revealed that he wasn't using time travel. The capsules he placed himself in werehibernation chambers that left him completely awake and aware while preserving his body for centuries or millennia. Apple of Discord: Van Kleiss tries this on Rex regarding his recently discovered brother. Seems to have worked, at least a little. Possibly subverted, as subsequent events made it so that one of the victims could only benefit from the gambit. Van Kleiss sowing s

characters.name: Biowulf
characters.description: An armored werewolf-like E.V.O. with superhuman abilities, Biowulf is fiercely loyal to Van Kleiss. Due to Van Kleiss' powers being limited to his native soil, Biowulf acts as the Pack's de facto leader. Affably Evil: He's quite gruff and cold most of the time, but after quite a while, he's mellowed somewhat. Defeat Means Friendship:With Rex, during "Assault on Abysus". The battle was largely ceremonial, though, and it was implied that he was already willing to give Rex a fair shake. Dragon Ascendant: After Van Kleiss disappears, he becomes the Pack's new leader. The Faceless: He's constantly wearing a metallic wolf mask, so we never see his real face.

characters.name: Breach
characters.description: Breach can open portals from anywhere to anywhere else, making her the Pack's main form of transportation. In addition to that, she can also fire the portals at her enemies like shuriken and send attacks through them. With these E.V.O. powers and Breach's insanity, she is the Pack's most unpredictable member. It was later revealed that she took the city of Greenville, OH, and turned that place into her personal dollhouse. She uses this "dollhouse" to keep "shiny things" and has captive E.V.O.s fight each other. And I Must Scream: Is forced to follow Van Kleiss through time forsix thousand yearsuntil Rex manages to free her. Back for the Finale:She returns in the final episode of the series, to take Biowulf, Skalamander and Van Kleiss through one of her portals for either apayback, or asequel hook. Berserk Button: She doesn't like it when you break her "toys".

characters.name: Skalamander
characters.description: A humanoid lizard E.V.O. with crystal spikes growing out from all over his body and a crystal club growing out of his left arm. He can fire said spikes out of the club or grow it into a shield, providing short or long-range attacks, as well as defensive abilities. Body Horror: There's no way to sugarcoat this; he looks like his neck has been snapped, fatally. His neck is even twisted in a way that evokes lethal implications. And that's before you take into account that it snapped straight in the air! Up and to the side, both at 90-degree angles. He's a good example of an E.V.O. who looks like his mutation could have killed him. He's constantly left drooling by the odd angle of his mouth, another sign that the design of his body is to a certain degree working against him... The Brute:Played With. Though he's definitely the team muscle, he's less aggressive than he looks and actually tries to keep the peace between the Pack and Providence at the beginning of Leader of the Pack. Gemstone Assault: He can shoot the crystals growing out of his body. Mysterious Past: Nothing is known about him before he joined the Pack.

characters.name: Jungle Cat
characters.description: Jungle Cat is an E.V.O. that was seen having joined The Pack shortly after Breach's disappearance, and helping Van Kleiss look for Dr. Rylander's laboratory. He accidentally cuts one of the pipes providing Van Kleiss with Abysus. He was drained of nanites by Van Kleiss, and turned to stone...Amazingly, it did not take. He has now joined Providence, hoping to get revenge on Van Kleiss. Boisterous Bruiser: On one occasion, he's dealing with a pack of Providence grunts when he spots Black Knight about to take one of the Meta-Nanites. He beams her with a Providence soldier to stop her. Cue epic victory pose. Determinator:He can overcome the petrification Van Kleiss imposed on him bysheer willpower. In-Series Nickname: Rex refers to him as "the cat". Mistreatment-Induced Betrayal:Attempted murder tends to have that effect.

characters.name: I-Bol
characters.description: The Bus Came Back: After an appearance in the season 1 finale and a cameo in season 2, I-Bol pretty much disappeared from the series until the comic follow-up to the "Heroes United" crossover withBen 10: Ultimate Alien, which gave it a starring role as a major member of the Pack along with Biowolf and Skalamander. This is also when its name is first given. Support Party Member: Strictly a noncombatant, there for technical support and comms. TV Head Robot: Minus the robot, but otherwise accurate, its large eye can be used as a computer screen, allowing it to display video communications with Van Kleiss's various agents. The Unintelligible: While it never speaks in the series proper, it does in the comic, except everything it says is in indistinguishable beeps and buzzes. It's unclear if Biowolf can understand it, but Skalamander can.

characters.name: One
characters.description: The leader and master of the group, One was the most dangerous man on the planet until he started going E.V.O., leading him to be imprisoned on an isolated island for his own safety. Ascended to a Higher Plane of Existence:Implied after he had willingly died and the once-barren land of the volcanic island began to bloom with vegetation.Six: He is still One. He is just one with everything. Big Red Devil: His E.V.O. form. Perhaps fitting for the most dangerous man in the world, especially since he sealed himself in a volcanic prison. Cool Old Guy: He was the most dangerous man in the world before he turned into an E.V.O. and is inferred to be the oldest of the Six. Dead Man's Switch: He's been able to keep himself contained via one; if he doesn't enter a code into his cell every 41 minutes, the whole thing drops into lava. This also implies his mutation has left him asThe Sleepless.

characters.name: Dos
characters.description: Dos ("two" in Spanish) is an elderly Spanish gentleman and the second most dangerous man on the planet. Cane Fu: When he's not using the sword inside. Cool Old Guy: He's the oldest of the five we see, and the Second most dangerous man on the planet.Or the most dangerous, after One's death. Eyes Always Shut: His eyes appear to be constantly shut. Instant Sedation: His cane hasKnockout Gas, which he uses on Rex to bring him to cure One.

characters.name: Trey
characters.description: Trey (from the Old French word treis, meaning "three") is the third most dangerous man on the planet. Badass Normal: He's not an E.V.O., but he can still give Rex a good fight. Bare-Fisted Monk: The only one to fight without a weapon. As he puts it, "a dangerous man only need these right here!" Beware the Silly Ones: Despite his goofy demeanor, he's still a dangerous assassin. Dumb Muscle: Seems to rely on brute strength and isn't the brightest bulb of the bunch.

characters.name: IV
characters.description: IV (Roman numeral for "four" and pronounced "ivy") is a mummy-like mercenary who is the fourth most dangerous person on the planet. Bandage Mummy: Certainly has the appearance of one. Deadpan Snarker: Has a few moments. Empowered Badass Normal: Not an E.V.O., but can still manipulate his bandages at will. Noodle Incident: The Malaysian job. He lost a pinky finger, apparently.

characters.name: Five
characters.description: Five is a pink-haired English rocker, as shown by her unique sense of fashion and guitar. She is the fifth most dangerous person on the planet and the only female member of The Six. Affably Evil: While she is neutral, she's come into conflict with the protagonists several times, but is always pleasant about it. She seems to be the only one of the Six to actually keep in contact with Six, getting him information and encouraging his relationship with Holiday. Badass Normal: She's a normal human, but is still considered the fifth most dangerous person in the world and the most dangerous woman in the world. Color-Coded for Your Convenience: Pink hair, pink clothes, and a pink guitar. Instrument of Murder: She fights with a guitar.

characters.name: Circe
characters.description: Circe is very similar to Rex, as she looks perfectly human until she starts using her powers. She has a secondary mouth that she uses to fire sonic screeches at her enemies. Her reasoning for why she has teamed up with the Pack is that she feels like too much of an outsider to go anywhere else. Rex constantly tries to get her to switch sides. Bad Powers, Good People: Despite her astonishingly freaky-looking mutation, she's one of the nicer E.V.O.s.Particularly after herHeel–Face Turn. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: Strongly averted with her powers, whichrip her face openevery time she uses them. Although her face always goes back to normal afterward. Conflicting Loyalty: Between Rex and Van Kleiss.Eventually she chooses Rex. Dating Catwoman: She really does want to be friends (and also hinted to want to be even more than friends) with Rex, but the Pack isn't exactly happy with that...Van Kleiss, on the other hand, ismore than willing to use thisas part of his long-term plan to get to Rex.

characters.name: Tuck
characters.description: Tuck is an old and good friend of Rex's. He was an E.V.O. and a member of Rex's old street gang in Hong Kong, along with his companions Skwydd and Cricket. Mummy: Sort of. He's all bandage and no mummy. The Lancer: Was apparently this back when Rex was with the gang. She Is Not My Girlfriend: Cricket, that is.

characters.name: Skwydd
characters.description: Skwydd (pronounced "squid") was an old teammate and good friend of Rex's. When living in Hong Kong, he formed a street gang with other fellow E.V.O.s. Cthulhumanoid: Has a squid face, hence the name. Given Name Reveal: In the finale, it's revealed that his real name is Walter. Jumping on a Grenade: Sort of. In "Lost Weekend," his abilities are temporarily modified so that his smokescreen comes out solid, and he uses this to contain an exploding E.V.O. She Is Not My Girlfriend: With Circe.

characters.name: Cricket
characters.description: Cricket is a friend of Rex's and a member of his old gang in Hong Kong. Cute Monster Girl: The only thing noticeably "E.V.O." thing about her is her legs. Beyond that, she's very cute. Everyone Can See It: Apparently, she had a crush on Rex when he was with the gang, and he was either oblivious or pretending to be. It's hard to say;he was kind of an asshole back then. Fragile Speedster: She uses her speed and kicks in combat, but can be knocked out with only a few hits. Kick Chick: Her main E.V.O. ability gives her very powerful legs, which she uses to beat her enemies. She's even given Rex a hard time fighting against her.

characters.name: Zag RS
characters.description: A rogue AI with a desire to eliminate all nanites, which consequently includes every living thing. A.I. Is a Crapshoot: Was created by Caesar to contain any rogue nanites, and now wants to destroy the world as a result. Big "NO!": Lets one out at the end of her first appearance in "The Architect". Gone Horribly Right: She was created to contain any rogue nanites, and becauseall living creatureshave rogue nanites inside them, so... Manipulative Bitch: She's very good at getting humans to do what she wants, first tricking an entire colony of people into helping her build aDoomsday Deviceand in her second appearancehiding out in their robot buddy until they'd done everything she needed them to do.

characters.name: NoFace
characters.description: A powerful E.V.O. who can control the E.V.O. population of the Bug Jar (formerly Kiev, Ukraine). Alas, Poor Villain: In the beginning, all he wanted was to get out of the area in which he was imprisoned; unfortunately, his plan to escape fails due to Rex's interference, causing sadness and depression to him. Bare-Fisted Monk: Aside from his ability to communicate with other E.V.O.s, he lacks any of the powers or advanced technologies employed by other villains. He still manages to be an extremely dangerous opponent by combining his E.V.O. physicals with a vicious and highly coordinated fighting style. The Beast Master: He has the ability to control non-sapient E.V.O.s, also known as the entire bug jar. The Blank: As his name says, he literally has no face.

characters.name: Hunter Cain
characters.description: Hunter Cain is a vigilante who strongly dislikes E.V.O.s and is one of Rex's enemies. Attempting to give Rexa bad reputation, Cain was exposed for cloning E.V.O.s to build his own image to his followers. Since then, he has made Rex a permanent target for his revenge, being labeled a nemesis of Rex. Ambiguously Trained: Hunter Cain clearly shows plenty of martial prowess by briefly defeating Rex on his own, but it's not clear if he was ex-military or was trained by a possible underground paramilitary group after losing his wife. Badass Normal: He doesn't have any superpowers or even cybernetics, but is nonetheless capable of holding his own against E.V.O.s through his own martial prowess, anti-nanite weapons, andThe Power of Hate. Bald of Evil: With a scar on the top. BFG: He mainly wields a customized grenade launcher capable of firing anti-nanite rounds.

characters.name: Peter Meechum
characters.description: Dr. Peter Meechum is the father of Sarah Meechum and a scientist involved with the Nanite Project. Once an E.V.O., Peter had the power to "zombify" people that came in contact with him by a simple touch. He let himself be cured after Rex promised he'd rescue his daughter from Van Kleiss. He later reappeared as a scientist for Providence and Black Knight to resume the Nanite Project. 10-Minute Retirement:In the finale, he vows to never work with the other scientists again in the wake of all that's happened. But the others convince him to give it a second chance. Foreshadowing: The fact that he was able to resist Rex trying to cure him, unlike other E.V.O.s, possibly hints that he was one of the scientists behind the Nanite Project. People Puppets: Peter Meechum, as an E.V.O., can activate the Nanites in anyone he touches, granting him control of their muscles, but not their minds. The one guy Providence captured who had been affected, though, was a remarkably good sport about it. The rest just keep quiet.

characters.name: Gabriel Rylander
characters.description: Dr. Gabriel Rylander was an evolutionary biologist and a leading expert in nanotechnology. He later worked on the Nanite Project along with other scientists before the Nanite Event. The Disembodied: After he's revived, he's reduced to a phantom in a jar. His Name Is...: Rylander is impaled by Van Kleiss before he can spill Rex's backstory. While this doesn't kill Rylander, the effect is the same. What makes the use of this trope especially blatant is that Rex had just called him out for being so cryptic, and Rylander had apologized for it, realizing how long Rex had been desperately trying to find the answers, just in time for Van Kleiss to show up. I Did What I Had to Do: He and the other scientists who were working on the Nanite Project are always saying that. Meaningful Name: Gabriel Rylander and Rafael Salazar, the two leading scientists on the Nanite Project, share their names with two archangels.

characters.name: Claire Bowman and Annie
characters.description: A pair of "normal" teenage girls who go on double dates with Rex and Noah. They're both scientific prodigies, and Annie has notoriously dangerous bad luck. So bad that Noah recruited Rex to go out with her because he didn't think anybody else could survive the experience. Actor Allusion:In "Operation: Wingman". Noah, who is played byFred Savage, goes to prom with Claire, voiced byDanica McKellar, who is well-known for playing Savage's love interest Winnie Cooper inThe Wonder YearsAnnie's hair resembles her voice actressFelicia Dayhaircut from 2010. In "Operation: Wingman". Noah, who is played byFred Savage, goes to prom with Claire, voiced byDanica McKellar, who is well-known for playing Savage's love interest Winnie Cooper inThe Wonder Years Annie's hair resembles her voice actressFelicia Dayhaircut from 2010. Badass Normal: They do not have supernatural abilities, if you do not consider Annie's instantaneous bad luck as a super power, yet they are able to act badass while facing very strong enemies.

characters.name: Gatlocke
characters.description: Gatlocke is a modern-day pirate who attempted to steal a shipment of unstable nanites from Providence. He was captured and eventually arrested by Providence. Later, he broke out of prison to gain revenge on Rex, but ultimately failed. Affably Evil: Is surprisingly polite to his enemies even in battle. Arm Cannon: His two cybernetic arms can turn into energy canons. Berserk Button: Donotcall him "common." Blade Below the Shoulder: His two cybernetic arms are equipped with retractable blades.

characters.name: Branden Moses
characters.description: A famous scientist who has seemingly discovered a cure for all E.V.O.s. In reality, he's a fraud who sells his E.V.O. patients asSuper Soldiersto the highest bidder. The Antichrist: Well, more like "The Anti-Moses", but same basic principle. Pretends to want to cure E.V.O.s (supposedly freeing them of their condition, so to speak), but instead enslaves them, the opposite of what the actual Moses wanted and tried to do, which was to free slaves. Auction of Evil: Runs one where he sells incurable E.V.O.s as Super Soldiers. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Promises a cure, but it turns out to be a scam. Faux Affably Evil: Pretends to be nice...until his true colors are revealed.

characters.name: Quarry
characters.description: An E.V.O. crime lord whom Rex used to work for, prior to losing his memories. And I Must Scream: Even shattering him apparently doesn't kill him. It does make any sort of communication difficult, though.Though considering the events of the finale, it's highly likely he would've been killed if he was hit by the cure wave. Detachment Combat: In his third appearance, he can use his fist like a whip. This is apparently because of the injuries Van Kleiss inflicted on him. Faux Affably Evil: He puts up a friendly act, but he's a ruthless manipulator who's only out for himself. Literally Shattered Lives: It's all but stated outright that Van Kleiss punished him for his betrayal by breaking his body apart. His new outfit is apparently the only thing holding him together. Taken a step further when Rex hits him with his spinning giant fist, outright shattering him into chunks.

characters.name: John Scarecrow
characters.description: John Scarecrow is a shape-shifting E.V.O. who had conflicts with Rex's old gang and personal problems with Rex Salazar himself. He made an alliance with Black Knight and returned to get revenge on Rex by successfully infiltrating The Plant. Chekhov's Gunman: He was mentioned by Skwydd in "Rabble". Evil Is Petty: He actually succeeded in his mission of sending the data on the Meta-Nanites to Providence early on. The rest of his interactions with Rex and Co. were just for the sake of messing with Rex's head. A House Divided: Part of hisShapeshifter Guilt Triptactics. It succeeds. Lean and Mean: Having the appearance of a scarecrow, this isn't surprising.

characters.name: Alpha
characters.description: Alpha is the original control nanite created by Cesar but sent to an empty dimension, where he started attempting to merge with organic lifeforms in his pursuit of a stable body. Unfortunately, that universe turned out to be the Null Void. He found a host and forced a return to Rex's world, accidentally taking Ben Tennyson with him and setting up the crossover. A.I. Is a Crapshoot: Making an artificially intelligent control nanite worked just about as well as one would expect it. Cesar seems to have a poor track record with this sort of thing. Big Bad: OfBen 10/Generator Rex: Heroes United. Big Red Devil: Other than the mechanical form he first appears in, all his forms are quite demonic in appearance, getting even more so as he transforms into more powerful forms. Evil Counterpart: To Rex's Omega Nanite, if the name didn't tip you off.
